concerns.text: FR-001 requires outputting a labeled dataset with specific structural features. Task T011b is marked as incomplete (checkbox empty) and depends on T036/T050. While T036 and T050 are marked complete, T011b itself is not implemented, leaving the core requirement of generating `failure_cases.json` and its splits unaddressed in the task list.

FR-002 requires generating a rule library covering ≥90% of patterns. Task T013 (Distillation) is marked complete, but T015b (Schema Validation of the generated rules) is marked incomplete. Without T015b, there is no task ensuring the output of T013 conforms to the contract `distilled_rule.schema.yaml`, leaving the requirement partially unverified.

FR-004 and SC-001 require a paired comparison of Time-to-Pivot. Task T019 (Run Experiments) and T020 (Record Metrics) are marked incomplete. T019a (Manifest Generation) is also incomplete. Without these tasks, the execution of the rule engine on the test set and the recording of metrics are missing, blocking the core comparative analysis.

FR-004 requires baseline execution. Task T021 (Run Baseline) and T021c (Instrument Baseline) are marked complete, but T022 (Data Merging) is marked incomplete. The merging of rule engine and baseline results is a prerequisite for the statistical analysis (T026a, T029a). The missing T022 task breaks the data flow for FR-005 and FR-006.

FR-006 and SC-003 require mixed-effects logistic regression. Tasks T026a (Model Fitting) and T026b (Significance Determination) are marked incomplete. T025 (Implement Model) is marked complete, but the actual execution and output generation tasks are missing, leaving the primary success criterion unmeasured.

SC-001 requires a paired t-test/Wilcoxon test on Time-to-Pivot. Task T029a (Tobit Regression implementation) is marked incomplete. While T029c (Execute) is also incomplete, the implementation task itself is not checked, meaning the statistical method for handling censored data is not defined in the tasks.

SC-002 requires stratified success rates. Task T029b (Calculate Stratified Rates) and T029d (Execute) are marked incomplete. The implementation and execution of this specific success criterion are missing.

FR-007 requires categorizing failed pivots. Task T027 (Error Taxonomy) and T027b (Execute) are marked incomplete. The logic to distinguish 'Coverage Gap' vs 'Distillation Error' is not implemented in the task list.

SC-004 requires measuring the proportion of Coverage Gap vs Distillation Error. This relies on T027/T027b which are incomplete. Additionally, T028 (Ground Truth Arbitration) is marked incomplete, which is a dependency for T027.

SC-005 requires measuring total compute time. Task T030b (Aggregate External Resources) is marked complete, but T030a (Aggregate Local Resources) is marked complete. However, the final report generation T029f depends on T030b. The critical path for SC-005 seems partially covered, but the dependency chain is broken by missing upstream tasks (T022, T026a).

Task T060 (Implement Final Orchestration Script) is marked incomplete. This task is critical for the 'run-book vs implementation mismatch' and serves as the single entry point for the pipeline. Its absence leaves the execution flow unorchestrated.

Task T061 (Enforce Streaming-First Data Loading) is marked incomplete. This is a direct response to the 'Data Hygiene & Streaming' analysis finding. Without this task, the memory constraint handling for large datasets is not explicitly enforced in the implementation plan.

Task T062 (Implement Paired-Data Integrity Check) is marked incomplete. This addresses the 'Execution Order & Data Flow' concern. Without it, the paired comparison required by SC-001 is not validated for data integrity.
Task T063 (Add Sensitivity Analysis for Censoring Threshold) is marked incomplete. This addresses the robustness of SC-001. The implementation is missing.

Task T011b is tagged with [FR-001] but is marked as incomplete (empty checkbox). The tag implies coverage, but the task status indicates the work is not done. This creates a false positive in the traceability matrix.
Task T019 is tagged with [US2] but is marked incomplete. The tag suggests coverage of the user story, but the task is not implemented.
Task T026a and T026b are tagged with [US3] and [SC-003] respectively but are marked incomplete. The tags imply coverage, but the tasks are not executed.
